_doc: Hard limits from docs/DESIGN.md section 5. Enforced before orders.approved; breaches also feed the kill switch.
_shadow_mode_doc: true = validator verdicts are recorded and ignored (mandatory first phase). false = anything other than APPROVE is rejected.
_max_spread_bps_doc: Raised from 10bp for the v1.1 universe. A 10bp guard is a large-cap setting and silently rejected every $1-5B candidate (639 of 1169 in the v1.1 single pass). It must stay consistent with backtest costs.default_spread_bps or the backtest trades names the live risk manager would refuse.
